map.经济困难标准: 家庭人均月收入 ≤ 当地低收入线（低保/特困/残疾/未成年/70: Hardship standard: monthly household income per capita ≤ the local low-income line, with groups such as subsistence-allowance recipients, the extremely poor, persons with disabilities, minors, people over 70 and entitled groups exempt from the means test
map.法律援助事项须属于法律援助范围；申请人若为低保户、特困人员、残疾人、未成年人、七: The matter must fall within the scope of legal aid. Applicants who are subsistence-allowance households, people in extreme poverty, persons with disabilities, minors, people aged 70 or over, or rural migrant workers are exempt from the means test. Other applicants must have a household per-capita income no higher than the local low-income standard, and the matter must fall within the prescribed scope of representation or criminal defence.
